en-US.description: Bulk program uninstaller with advanced automation. It excels at removing large amounts of applications with minimal to no user input, while requiring next to no technical knowledge.
en-US.longDescription:
Bulk Crap Uninstaller (or BCUninstaller) is a free (as in speech) program uninstaller.
It excels at removing large amounts of applications with minimal user input.
It can clean up leftovers, detect orphaned applications, run uninstallers according to premade lists, and much more!
Even though BCU was made with IT pros in mind, by default it is so straight-forward that anyone can use it.

BCU is fully compatible with Windows Store Apps, Steam, Windows Features and has special support for many uninstalling systems (NSIS, InnoSetup, Msiexec, and many other).
en-US.name: BCUninstaller

zh-CN.description: 具有高级自动化功能的批量程序卸载程序。它擅长以最少甚至无需用户输入的方式卸载大量应用程序，同时几乎不需要任何技术知识。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Bulk Crap Uninstaller（简称 BCUninstaller）是一款自由的程序卸载软件。
它擅长以最少的用户输入卸载大量应用程序。
它可以清理残留、检测孤立应用程序、按预置列表运行卸载程序等等！
虽然 BCU 是为 IT 专业人士设计的，但默认情况下它非常简单直观，任何人都能使用。

BCU 完全兼容 Windows 商店应用、Steam、Windows 功能，并对许多卸载系统（NSIS、InnoSetup、Msiexec 等）提供特别支持。
